prompt.value: Consider you have a file in your hard disk of size 1000 KB. Seek time of your hard disk read head is 3ms and rotational speed in 30,000 rpm. The disk has 200 sectors per track and 512 bytes per sector. Considering the fact that the file data is stored in non consecutive sectors. How much time will be required to read the whole file after a read request is made? (in ms)
